title: Sizing & clearspace
slide_intent: Show how a feature of the symbol can set its own clearance. A repeatable measurement keeps surrounding elements from crowding the person.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can preserve the figure’s silhouette on small items and allow partners to size it from the artwork itself.
demonstration: Pale circles repeat the head-height measurement around the black symbol. Magenta rules mark the surrounding enclosure and a separate sample shows the minimum size.
practical_value: Leave at least two head heights of space and check the specified minima of 5 mm wide in print or 25 px on screen.

content_islands.name: Rule and explanation
content_islands.spec: Use the narrow text column to explain the head-height clearance rule and the role of the minimum size.

content_islands.name: Clearance construction
content_islands.spec: Center a black symbol in a large annotated rectangle. Repeat the head as pale circles to show how two head heights measure the perimeter.

content_islands.name: Small-size specimen
content_islands.spec: Place a tiny reproduction beneath the diagram with separate print and screen values.
